title: Paladin of Deseret: Novice
author: Sklar K
desc:
Introduces the novice to a 3x day a week full-body hypertrophy program. Workouts are 45min to an hour. This will focus on progressive overload through evolving repetitions and the addition of weight after the target repetitions are hit. The key for this program is intensity. Remain close to failure with the sets. Main movements can be hit as 2 sets instead of 3 sets to accommodate the lifters fatigue if necessary but is not recommended to always be done. It is recommended to stick to minimum variations of the same movements at first. 

A thick lifting belt will be nice to have eventually for squat and hinge movements but is not necessary. Lifting straps will be nice to carry weight heavier than your grip but are not necessary and there are other grips such as alternate and hook grip.

ex.note: I would do try to do at least one warm up set before these working sets. Use a regular barbell or safety squat bar.

ss.note: Do one arm and then another. I like to face away from the cable tower and do the extension to my front different from how this app proposes the lift.
Slow and controlled. Don't have to go all the way down but pretty far down and keep it consistent.

ex.note: Should be more than warmed up from previous exercises. Do either close grip or dumbell but track progress for whichever one.
Do it a little extra inclined so it's a bit closer to an over head press as to target shoulders more. Make sure the bench is not fully vertical, however.
Use decline sit-up bench if possible. Progressively overload with more reps or add weight by holding a dumbell towards the top of your head and add weight over time.

Use the already loaded trap bar and shrug to make your traps meat mountains.
